name: Gloo Holdings (Nasdaq) — faith-tech platform roll-up
source: blob_sweep 2026-08-18 (dd52 -67.9%, excess vs Technology median -0.355); refutability 2026-08-21 scored 4/10 — below the >=6 auto-escalate bar, NO red/blue court routed; adjudicated 2026-08-22
verdict: NO-COURT / SCREEN-ARTIFACT — the dislocation that triggered this row is mostly float mechanics, not narrative selling. The $9.98 52-week high was printed on a squeezed ~4.7M-share pre-deal float; the 2026-07-08 offering sold 7.0M new Class A at $3.25 (~150% float expansion), so dd52/excess_dd are measured off a reference price that never cleared real supply (§beta-bleed-is-not-dislocation / §mispricing-artifact-taxonomy: supply normalization). Operating damage is genuinely absent (Q1 rev $41.5M +238% beat, FY26 guide RAISED to $195M, GM 27.9%->32.3%, insiders — Beck, Gelsinger — funded >=$6.0M of the $22.75M discounted raise), but two structural facts cap any interest: gross margin is services-economics (26.7% TTM), and equity issuance is the business model (shares +415% in one year, acquisitions the stated use of proceeds). Even a favorable verdict runs into a ~$40M float that caps size before conviction does, and the decisive Q2 test ($44.0M rev / -$8.5M adj EBITDA, then Q3-breakeven -> Q4-profitability path) prints ~2026-09-08 for free.
conviction: refutability bench 4/10 court-worthiness; disposition ratified at adjudication — a court would change almost nothing
position: NONE — no starter, no gate. This is not a §CLEAN-COURT-MINIMUM-STARTER case: no adversarial court ran (below threshold), so the minimum-starter default does not attach.
watch: Q2 print ~2026-09-08 (UNCONFIRMED; date-PR due ~8/27 per Q1 precedent) — free look at the $44.0M / -$8.5M guide and the Q4-profitability path
If Q2 beats AND Q3 guides to breakeven: re-run refutability with the float-artifact drawdown EXCLUDED from the score
